name: SPD-SL light-action pedal pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 330 g for the left/right PD-R540-LA SPD-SL pedal pair, using the handbook’s explicit pair-weight row. Cleat and loose-accessory inclusion is not specified in the weight row. This is the separately listed lighter-spring-action model.
